status_definitions.TASK_EVIDENCE_PATHWAY: PC is listed in >=1 of T1-T5's linked_pcs. This is a PACK-DESIGN fact, not proof of evidence: it means an assessor CAN score this PC 0-3 from captured evidence IF that evidence actually shows it. See mvp_applicability for PCs where even that is structurally impossible, and docs/evidence_status_model.md for the full per-assessment outcome contract (DEMONSTRATED / NOT_OBSERVABLE / NOT_APPLICABLE_IN_MVP) that P2 must implement on top of this.
status_definitions.DECLARATION_OR_ASSESSOR_NOTE: PC belongs to CON/N8001, CON/N8002 or DGT/VSQ/N0101 -- covered only by the worker's self-declaration plus up to 3 short assessor questions, recorded as notes. No task evidence, no 0-3 rubric score. Stated MVP limitation, not an oversight.
status_definitions.NOT_ASSESSED_IN_MVP: PC has no task reference and is not in a declaration-only NOS. Must be an empty set for the pinned CON/Q0602 v4.0 pack -- pack_validate.py's [links] check fails the build otherwise.

outcome_model.purpose: Two separate axes. Axis 1 (this file, pack-design-time, same for every assessment): which EVIDENCE PATHWAY exists for a PC in the fixed T1-T5 structure. Axis 2 (assessment-time, per real submitted evidence, P2/P6 scope -- not yet implemented, this is the contract for it): what the assessor actually recorded for THIS worker's THIS submission. A PC being on the TASK_EVIDENCE_PATHWAY is NOT proof it was demonstrated -- it only means an assessor CAN judge it from T1-T5 evidence if that evidence shows it.

axis_1_pathway.TASK_EVIDENCE_PATHWAY: PC is linked to >=1 of T1-T5 (tasks.json linked_pcs). An assessor MAY score it 0-3 from captured evidence -- IF that evidence actually shows it (see axis 2).
axis_1_pathway.DECLARATION_OR_ASSESSOR_NOTE: PC belongs to CON/N8001, CON/N8002 or DGT/VSQ/N0101. Self-declaration + up to 3 assessor questions only. Never enters axis 2 at all -- there is no 0-3 score to withhold or grant.
axis_1_pathway.NOT_ASSESSED_IN_MVP: No pathway at all. Must be empty for the pinned pack.

axis_2_assessor_outcome_contract_for_p2.applies_to: TASK_EVIDENCE_PATHWAY PCs only, recorded per assessment (not per pack)
axis_2_assessor_outcome_contract_for_p2.DEMONSTRATED: Assessor reviewed the submitted T1-T5 evidence and it clearly shows this PC; scored 0-3 against rubric.json anchors.
axis_2_assessor_outcome_contract_for_p2.NOT_OBSERVABLE: PC is on the TASK_EVIDENCE_PATHWAY and evidence was submitted for that task, but it does not show this specific PC (bad angle, skipped step, too short, etc). No score; drives a reassessment request (see master plan Fig.5), not a 0.
axis_2_assessor_outcome_contract_for_p2.NOT_APPLICABLE_IN_MVP: PC's mvp_applicability is NOT_APPLICABLE_IN_MVP (axis-1 pack data) -- pre-set, not assessor-judged per submission, because no evidence setup could ever show it in this MVP. Never scored, never requested for reassessment.
axis_2_assessor_outcome_contract_for_p2.required_api_distinction: Any profile/report/API output MUST render these as 4 visibly distinct categories, never collapsed into one score list: demonstrated (axis2=DEMONSTRATED), declaration-only (axis1=DECLARATION_OR_ASSESSOR_NOTE), not-observable (axis2=NOT_OBSERVABLE), not-applicable (axis2=NOT_APPLICABLE_IN_MVP / axis1 mvp_applicability=NOT_APPLICABLE_IN_MVP).

outcome_model.wording_rule: No UI, API response, or generated report may use 'certified', 'official pass', or 'official certificate'. Use 'NSQF-aligned competency profile and assessor recommendation'.
